proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_record
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord does not include a MagicItemRecord kind. The v4 taxonomy has magic_item_root but no corresponding record type, mechanics family, or tracer branch exists in the surface. Every magic item hits this blocker before any mechanic-level question arises.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Apparatus of the Crab — Wondrous Item, Legendary

proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_object_family
proposed_widenings.justification: The apparatus is a rideable object with its own stat block (AC, HP, Speed, damage immunities). No mechanics family models an object with independent stats that occupants pilot. This is structurally distinct from all four spell families and the class-feature activation family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft.; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

proposed_widenings.name: lever_multimode_activation
proposed_widenings.justification: Ten levers each have an Up and Down mode producing independent effects (movement, attack, light, window, depth control, hatch). No mechanics family models a multi-mode stateful control panel where a single Utilize action dispatches to one of N×2 effect branches.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position.

proposed_widenings.name: fixed_numeric_attack_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: The claw attacks use +8 to hit — a fixed numeric bonus unrelated to caster spell save DC or weapon-attack-rooted DC formula. DcSource has caster_spell_save_dc and weapon_attack_dc (base + ability mod + PB); neither covers a hardcoded integer bonus.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.

proposed_widenings.name: condition_grappled
proposed_widenings.justification: Lever 5 down applies the Grappled condition with escape DC 15. The Condition type only contains 'prone'. Grappled is a distinct SRD condition requiring its own variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not in UnitRecord. Even if it were, five additional gaps would prevent clean encoding: vehicle object family, lever multi-mode activation, fixed numeric attack bonus, Grappled condition variant, and (minor) underwater pressure damage-per-minute mechanic. The apparatus is the most mechanically complex item in the SRD magic item list — it effectively requires a mini vehicle subsystem.
